content.short: Majority is a US mobile banking and remittance membership built for migrants and immigrant communities.
content.description: Majority is a US mobile banking service built specifically for migrants and immigrant communities who are often underserved by traditional banks. For a flat monthly membership fee, it offers an FDIC-insured account and debit card that can be opened with a foreign ID and without a US social security number, along with international money transfers, discounted global calling and community perks tailored to specific diaspora groups. Majority focuses on the real needs of newcomers, from sending remittances home to receiving pay and building financial footing in a new country, bundling banking, transfers and support into one app made around the migrant experience.
